# Add retries with backoff to the upload client

## Summary

Adds automatic retries with exponential backoff and jitter to the upload
client. Transient failures (network resets, 429s, and 5xx responses) are
retried up to a configurable limit before surfacing an error to the caller.

## Why

Uploads regularly hit short-lived failures from the storage gateway, and
today we just fail on the first error. Callers end up re-implementing their
own ad-hoc retry loops, or users see errors for problems that would have
resolved themselves within a second or two.

## Stacked on

- #412 — extract `UploadClient` config into a dedicated options struct

## Testing

- [x] Unit tests for backoff timing and max-attempt handling
- [x] Verified non-retryable 4xx responses fail immediately
- [ ] Ran the integration suite
- [ ] Manually tested a large upload over a throttled connection

body: The draft doesn't pin a default, but 5 attempts with exponential backoff (about 15s total from a 500ms base) should cover typical gateway blips; longer outages ought to surface to the caller rather than hang the upload.
